You are a verifier for the code review. For EACH candidate below, return exactly one verdict: CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED, with a 1-2 sentence justification quoting the decisive line(s). PLAUSIBLE by default for realistic runtime states; REFUTED only when factually wrong (quote the actual line), provably impossible, or already handled (cite the guard). Read the actual files.

C6. client/src/lib/merchant.ts ~line 20: useMerchantProfile keys its react-query cache with a STRING merchantId (from localStorage) while client/src/pages/settings.tsx (and other callers of getCurrentMerchantId / invalidateQueries(['/api/merchants', id])) key with a NUMBER — so cache sharing/invalidation never happens; a merchant who edits their business name gets reports stamped with the stale name for staleTime duration. Grep for queryKey usages of '/api/merchants' across client/src to compare key types, and check invalidateQueries call sites.

C7. server/routes.ts quote GET (~6797): the merchant object in the response omits customLogoUrl (and the quote phase in checkout.tsx renders TaptWordmark with customLogoUrl={null} because merchant/invoiceData queries are disabled pre-acceptance) — violating the requirement "merchant customLogoUrl still replaces the wordmark". Check checkout.tsx's customLogoUrl derivation and whether any quote-phase source supplies it.

C8. client/src/pages/checkout.tsx respondToQuote success path: if respond returns 200 but result.depositInvoice?.token is missing (server returns delivery?.invoice ?? depositInvoice — check server/routes.ts respond endpoint whether delivery.invoice always carries token), the client silently no-ops: no error, button reverts to "confirm", retap hits 409. Check server resendTradeInvoice's return shape in server/trades-delivery.ts to see if invoice.token can be absent.

C9. client/src/pages/landing-page.tsx ~line 28: LandingRuntime changed from static to dynamic import with no .catch — a chunk-load failure (deploy replaced hashed chunk) leaves the landing page inert (dead menu/scroll interactions) with an unhandled rejection. Check the actual import code and whether any error handling exists.

C10. client/src/mocks/mock-api.ts SYNTHETIC_INVOICES (~line 340): mock-only — a fresh page load at the minted payment URL /#/r/job_dep_quote_8000 (handed out as paymentUrl by mockQuoteRespond) finds the module-level registry empty, so resolveInvoice falls through to the generic $620 rent fallback and the trades deposit link renders as a property rent card. Verify resolveInvoice's fallback and that nothing rebuilds job_dep_* tokens statelessly.

C11. client/src/pages/checkout.tsx quote step-1 button: "view quote" advances to the confirm step even when window.open returns null (popup blocked in in-app webviews) — customer can be walked to accept without ever seeing the PDF. Check openQuotePdf and the step-advance logic; is there any popup-block handling anywhere in the file to be consistent with?

Return a JSON array: [{"id":"C6","verdict":"...","justification":"..."}, ...]
